configurePresets.name: windows-clang-cl
configurePresets.description: Run from a VS Developer PowerShell so clang-cl, llvm-rc, lld-link and ninja are on PATH. CMAKE_RC_COMPILER is set to llvm-rc deliberately: the Windows SDK rc.exe is the only tool in this chain that is not long-path aware, and it fails with RC1109 when the build tree sits under a deep path. llvm-rc has no such limit, and this repo has no .rc files of its own, so it only ever compiles the manifest CMake generates.

configurePresets.name: windows-clang-cl-debug
configurePresets.description: Debug configuration. Engine changes should be checked here as well as in Release: Release passes some out-of-bounds reads silently.
